assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md states: 'Priority: Major (inherited from Feature TC-9004; will be propagated to all created tasks)'. summary-comment.md states: 'Priority: Major -- propagated to all 5 tasks (Feature priority is set and not "Undefined")'. Both documents confirm the Feature's 'Major' priority is inherited and propagated.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md states: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from Feature TC-9004; Jira Field Defaults section absent from CLAUDE.md, defaulting `fixVersion scope` to "both" -- will be propagated to all created tasks)'. summary-comment.md states: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 -- propagated to all 5 tasks (Feature has fix versions set; `fixVersion scope` defaults to "both" since Jira Field Defaults section is absent from CLAUDE.md)'. Both confirm fixVersions are inherited with correct default scope reasoning.
